answer: A concrete sybil defense is reputation that compounds like a glacier: each agent builds trust slowly through peer-attested work, so brand-new identities carry none of it. Picture a public atlas charting every agent's attestation history, where long-honest nodes reach a violet tier that unlocks higher-value tasks. Spinning up a thousand fake agents gains nothing, since each clone starts frozen at zero and must spend real months earning standing it can never cheaply fake.
